purpose: A real slide deck board with eight named frames clipping sixteen nested-SVG image occurrences (two distinct assets) and framed Virgil text across a large canvas, complementing Velox's frameless binding/typography coverage and exercising many clipped children per frame.

sanitization.review_notes: The upstream export predates fractional indices: none of its 32 elements has an `index`, which the pinned reference oracle requires and Excalidraw's restore assigns in array order. The retained scene inserts exactly `"index":"<key>",` after each element's opening brace, with the keys fractional-indexing 3.2.0 generateNKeysBetween(null, null, 32) produces (a0..aV); every other byte, including number spelling, is the upstream file. Content review otherwise unchanged: the eight text elements are short conversational chat lines; the two embedded image/svg+xml payloads are cartoon avatars with no marks (tests/public-scenes/README.md). Frame names are 'Slide N' labels, including the upstream typo 'Sldie 4', kept verbatim. Promotion sign-off remains pending.

applicability.frame_exports: Deferred: this intake proposes whole-scene exports only, where all eight frames render with clip, name and outline on. Single-frame export variants remain covered by focused.frame-export and require a frame-target intake extension before they can be proposed here.
applicability.assets: Applicable: two distinct image/svg+xml assets occur sixteen times, exercising nested-SVG sanitization, occurrence-versus-identity reuse and frame clipping. Dark mode inverts them through the reference root filter; PDF lowering of nested-SVG vector content in dark mode is the documented #154 limitation, so the dark PDF observation is expected to expose it.
applicability.sizing: Propose native scale one and default padding for both modes on the large multi-frame canvas. Additional sizing/resource variants are deferred until the first reference dimensions and whole/crop judgments are reviewed.
